Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to play a level 5 or lower Digimon card from the digivolution cards of this Digimon even when it doesn't have [MetalSeadramon] or [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when this card itself is played from digivolution cards?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] From the digivolution cards of this Digimon with [MetalSeadramon] or [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, you may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played from digivolution cards, ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
